versions.content: PduTriggering is referenced by several ContainerIPdu s In case a PduTriggering is referenced in the role ContainerIPdu . containedP- duTriggering by several ContainerIPdu s with ContainerIPdu . rxAcceptCon- tainedIPdu = RxAcceptContainedIPduEnum . acceptAll and has a reference to an IPduPort with direction IN then this PduTriggering shall only be considered once for the set of IPdu s which are considered for the reception of acceptAll Con- tainerIPdu s.
